analysis: The test invokes MSBuild to enumerate native publish items and parses the resulting JSON with System.Text.Json. The parse failure at a specific byte position ('M' after a single JSON value) indicates the captured MSBuild output stream was truncated or had extra content appended, which is an environmental/build-output-capture race rather than a logic defect. The PR under test only modifies Aspire.Dashboard and Aspire.Hosting log-source code and does not touch Hex1b, Infrastructure.Tests, or native publishing/MSBuild item generation.
